enrichment.headline: Accepts a $4.99M state grant to turn two elementary schoolyards into living schoolyards

enrichment.summary: The district accepts a grant from the state fire agency (CAL FIRE) to build outdoor classrooms, gardens, tree plantings and natural play areas at Manzanita Elementary and Martin Luther King Jr. Elementary. It will also continue its evaluation program and certification criteria for officials. The work runs from December 11, 2023 to June 30, 2024, and the Board is ratifying the agreement.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - East Bay Football Officials Association (EBFOA) - Oakland Athletic League (OAL)

enrichment.headline: Fred Finch Youth & Family Services provides two therapists at Garfield Elementary at no cost
enrichment.summary: Fred Finch Youth & Family Services will provide two therapists to hold 45 one-on-one sessions with up to ten students with mental health issues at Garfield Elementary School. It comes at no cost to the district and runs from October 24, 2023 to May 31, 2024. The Board is ratifying the agreement.

vendor.name: Fred Finch Youth Center dba Fred Finch Youth & Family Services

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement-2023-2024 - No-Cost - Fred Finch Youth Center dba Fred Finch Youth & Family Services - Garfield Elementary School

enrichment.headline: Destination College Advising Corps will place college advisers at six high schools at no cost
enrichment.summary: The University of California's Destination College Advising Corps will place college adviser fellows at Castlemont, Fremont, McClymonds, Oakland High, Oakland Tech and Skyline high schools. They provide college awareness, mentoring, advising and preparation to raise college-going rates. It costs the district nothing and runs from August 1, 2023 to June 30, 2026.

vendor.name: The Regents of the University of California, on behalf of Destination College Advising Corps (DCAC)

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Agreement - The Regents of the University of California - Destination College Advising Corps (DCAC) - FY2023-2024 - Named District Schools

enrichment.headline: Pays UC's Destination College Advising Corps up to $36,000 for college advisers at two high schools
enrichment.summary: The University of California's Destination College Advising Corps will place a college adviser fellow at Castlemont High School and Oakland High School. Advisers provide college awareness, mentoring and application help. The district pays up to $18,000 per school, up to $36,000 in total, from August 1, 2023 to June 30, 2024.

vendor.name: The Regents of the University of California, on behalf of Destination College Advising Corps (DCAC)

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Agreement - The Regents of the University of California - Destination College Advising Corps (DCAC) - FY2023-2026 - HS Linked Learning Office

enrichment.headline: Pays America SCORES Bay Area up to $374,172.40 for Saturday and after-school and after-school programs
enrichment.summary: America SCORES Bay Area will run ten 9-hour Saturday sessions in spring 2024 and support after-school programs at 28 school sites. It will also take part in a National Girls and Women in Sports Day event for upper elementary and middle school girls. The work runs from January 11 to May 25, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - America SCORES Bay Area - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Pays Soccer Without Borders up to $63,500 for a 10-week Saturday soccer program for newcomer students
enrichment.summary: Soccer Without Borders will run a 10-week Saturday sports program that offers organized recreation for newcomer elementary school students. High school newcomer youth will work as referees and assistant coaches to build leadership and job skills. The agreement runs from January 11 to May 25, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Soccer Without Borders - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $49,500 for school garden and food programs and stipends
enrichment.summary: The Oakland Public Education Fund will support environment, food and garden programming at school sites. It will pay stipends to the people who lead school learning spaces and will run programs for students and families. The agreement runs from December 7, 2023 to June 30, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Oakland Public Education Fund - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Adds $5,544 to Oakland Public Education Fund's contract for after-school media arts classes
enrichment.summary: This amendment adds after-school media arts classes at up to 7 campuses (elementary, middle and high school), two days per campus, for up to 20 students per class. It raises the contract limit from $109,050 to $114,594. The time period does not change.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Amendment No. 1, Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Oakland Public Education Fund - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Accepts free remote reading tutoring from OpenLiteracy for up to 200 students at six elementary schools
enrichment.summary: OpenLiteracy will provide remote one-on-one tutoring as an extra layer of intervention for up to 200 students, mostly in grades 1-3 at six schools. It costs the district nothing. The agreement runs from January 1 to May 31, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: No-Cost Service Agreement - OpenLiteracy - Tutoring - Academics and Instruction Department

enrichment.headline: Awards Purple Communications up to $276,000 for translation and interpretation services through 2026
enrichment.summary: Purple Communications will provide translation and interpretation services as needed, including in-person, video, phone and written document translation, for up to $276,000. A data sharing agreement (DSA) covers how student data is shared with and protected by the company. The term began August 7, 2023, before this approval, and runs through June 30, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement (Award of RFP No. 22-139OE Translation and Interpretation Services) and Data Sharing Agreement – Purple Communications, Inc. - Office of Equity

enrichment.headline: Accepts a federal human trafficking youth prevention education grant agreement running through 2028
enrichment.summary: The district enters a cooperative agreement with the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services to carry out a Human Trafficking Youth Prevention Education demonstration program grant. The agreement runs from September 30, 2023 through September 29, 2028, with yearly continuations that depend on performance and available funds. The text does not state a dollar amount.

vendor.name: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Administration for Children and Families

items.fundingSource: United States Department of Health and Human Services

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Cooperative Agreement - U.S. Department of Health and Human Services - Human Trafficking Youth Prevention Education Demonstration Program - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Approves up to $58,000 for Space80seven's music industry internship for 10 Fremont High students
enrichment.summary: Space80seven will run a hands-on music industry pre-apprenticeship internship for 10 students in Fremont High School's Media Academy, with mentors from the industry and career exploration field trips, including a two-day trip to Los Angeles. The Board is ratifying this agreement after its December 1, 2023 start date. It runs through June 30, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Space80seven, LLC - Fremont High School

enrichment.headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $3,921.50 for student behavior support at Brookfield Elementary
enrichment.summary: Bay Area Community Resources provided daily support for students with severe behavior and social-emotional challenges at Brookfield Elementary School. Staff met one-on-one with students to help solve problems and supervised recess and lunch. The service period, August 21 to November 17, 2023, ended before this approval.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Bay Area Community Resources - Brookfield Elementary School

enrichment.headline: Approves up to $37,855,000 for nonpublic schools and agencies serving special education students in 2023-24
enrichment.summary: This resolution authorizes new master agreements and individual service agreements with nonpublic, nonsectarian schools and agencies for students in special education during the 2023-24 school year. The total limit is $37,855,000, split into $9,100,000 for nonpublic schools and $28,755,000 for nonpublic agencies.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: New Master Agreements or Contracts and Individual Service Agreements with Nonpublic, Nonsectarian School/Agency Services - Students of Special Education Program - School Year 2023-2024 – Special Education Department

enrichment.headline: Accepts free one-on-one reading tutoring from Hoot Reading for 192 students at six schools
enrichment.summary: Hoot Reading will run a pilot of high-dosage one-on-one reading tutoring for 192 students at six schools, with three 30-minute lessons a week, plus virtual tutoring and a liaison for school leaders. It costs the district nothing. A data sharing agreement covers how student data is shared and protected. The term is January 16 to June 30, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted

enrichment.headline: Approves a no-cost Elmhurst United Middle School trip to a cheerleading competition in Las Vegas
enrichment.summary: The Board approves student travel to the JAMZ School Cheer Nationals 2024 Cheerleading Competition in Las Vegas, Nevada, for 15 students in grades 6-8 and 6 adults from Elmhurst United Middle School. The trip is January 25 to 28, 2024 and costs the district nothing.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Out of State Field Trip/Excursion - JAMZ School Cheer Nationals 2024 Cheerleading Competition - Elmhurst United Middle School

enrichment.headline: Ratifies the minutes of the Board's December 14, 2023 special meeting
enrichment.summary: The Board ratifies the written minutes of its December 14, 2023 special meeting, which staff prepared shortly after the meeting. No money is involved.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Minutes - Board of Education - Special Meeting – December 14, 2023

enrichment.headline: Pays Star Elevator up to $3,442 for elevator help during fire alarm testing at East Oakland Pride Elementary
enrichment.summary: Star Elevator will take each elevator out of service and assist while the district's fire alarm vendor tests the fire recall, then check that the elevators return to service. Work is scheduled from January 11 to March 30, 2024. Additional repairs, if needed, would be priced separately.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

schools: Melrose Leadership Academy at Maxwell Park
enrichment.summary: This amendment adds money for ongoing materials testing and special inspection services until the Living Schoolyard Project at Melrose Leadership Academy at Maxwell Park is complete. It raises the contract limit from $36,321 to $105,946.

enrichment.summary: DecoTech Systems will install four new exterior cameras outside the entry door of each of four buildings at Community Day School and connect them to the district's camera software. Work is scheduled from January 11 to March 15, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: This amendment adds architectural work for fencing, lighting, a new intrusion alarm for the whole campus and other renovations at the Kaiser Child Development Center. It raises the contract limit from $333,901 to $520,196 and extends the end date from October 1, 2023 to June 30, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: This change order replaces 3 more existing cameras and adds one camera at the Child Development Center building. It raises the contract limit from $191,720.74 to $199,189.03.
